groups.name: on-stop clause for ray / slide
groups.generator_spec: DRAW or MOVE(emitter, dir) with stop in {edge, contact, onto target, length = longest sibling run} and on_stop in {none, paint the reached grid side (side-side conflicts -> role colour), replace target, erase + bar at the opposite edge}, trail in {none, all swept, swept AND colour class}, plus a per-object branch on the measured property.

groups.name: virtual-anchor construction
groups.generator_spec: POINT(anchors) in {missing 4th rectangle corner, far bbox corner +/- 1 on the side picked by marker order, partner marker's cell, lattice origin + (i*p, j*p) registered from a partial copy}, used as an endpoint / target / stamp site by the existing connect, move and stamp actions.

groups.name: legend as sequence or shape table
groups.generator_spec: LEGEND kinds += {ordered sequence (collinear singletons), shape table (D8-canonical glyph -> colour)}; act += {bridge consecutive pairs (width = patch), bidirectional substitute (glyph -> fill and fill -> glyph)}.

groups.name: split and explode
groups.generator_spec: CUT(object, line) -> parts; each part MOVEs by its own rule (to its frame corner / away from the cut); an empty-corner part is removed.

groups.name: iterated local rule (cellular automaton)
groups.generator_spec: ITERATE over rows (or steps): cell <- T(neighbourhood), with T learned from the training pairs; stop at the last row or a fixed point.

groups.name: dock acceptance by complement
groups.generator_spec: DOCK criterion += complement: piece part + body = the body's filled bbox, with any opening side and grid-edge contact allowed.
